questions.question: A boat travels 16 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 16/2 = 8 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 8 − 2 = 6 km/h.
